decks.summary: Draw-everything Minh: Laboratory Assistant, Strange Solution, Preposterous Sketches and cycling skills keep a full hand, so Analytical Mind and her ability boost her own and her partner's tests every round.
Minh built on The Necronomicon and skills: Drawing Thin and Grisly Totem turn commits into money and draw, Mr. "Rook" and Studious dig for pieces, and the guide lists ten variants.
Beginner Minh from Core through Edge of the Earth who oversucceeds with skills to Scavenge her items back, investigates with Milan and Magnifying Glass, and pays with Schoffner's Catalogue.
Hard-mode Minh who draws huge hands with Drawing Thin, Grisly Totem and Mr. "Rook" and cashes them into Ancient Stone damage, while her skills handle the clues.

True solo Minh with near-infinite loops: Grim Memoir and Knowledge is Power give clues, fights and moves again and again while Cryptic Research and Practice Makes Perfect keep cards flowing; too strong for most tables.
Rules-edge combo Minh that commits skills under The King in Yellow with Practice Makes Perfect, drawing through Unrelenting, Survey the Area and Cryptic Research; a novelty build.
Cheap, fast Forgotten Age Minh who draws her deck with Preposterous Sketches, Working a Hunch and Madame Labranche, commits freely, and carries the clues in a two-player game.
Command-center Minh running a mobile field hospital: Alchemical Distillation heals the team, Survival Technique moves her Barricade, and Professor Webb and In the Know take clues from where she sits.
Spanish-language Carcosa Minh built purely as a multiplayer clue specialist, with Milan, Magnifying Glass, Newspaper and Archaic Glyphs to upgrade; not for solo.
Commit-support Minh who pushes teammates' investigations up to +5 with Sharp Vision and Grisly Totem through Analytical Mind, saving her own commits with Fieldwork and Mouse Mask.
